name: Shopify to Business Central - Order Create
description: Pulls paid Shopify orders created or updated since the last run (GraphQL, sortKey UPDATED_AT, cursor pagination, query = updated_at > watermark-rewind AND financial_status:paid) and drops everything already recorded in the shopify-orders-imported cross-reference ledger, so Business Central is only called for genuinely new orders. The remaining orders fan out one child transaction each, creating a BC sales order through the Fintegrator BC Connector extension, which de-duplicates on the Shopify order id as a second line of defence. The watermark rewind (ordersOverlapSeconds, default 900 = one cron interval) both closes the same-second gap and gives a failed import another chance while its order is still inside the window.
